neighbours.label: the word 'access' as a noun (access panels, access to water, access control)
fire: Every apartment in the building now has access to high-speed internet.
The plumber removed the access hatch behind the bathtub to reach the pipes.
Many rural villages still lack reliable access to clean drinking water.
Only staff with a valid badge are allowed through the access gate.
The new policy restricts access to patient records to the treating doctor.
Visitors with an all-access ticket can see every exhibit in the museum.
The database uses role-based access control for its administrators.
Wheelchair access is provided through the side entrance of the theatre.
quiet: Every apartment in the building now has a balcony and a small garden.
The plumber removed the panel behind the bathtub to reach the pipes.
Many rural villages still lack a reliable supply of electricity.
Only staff with a valid badge are allowed past the front desk.
The new policy limits who may read patient records to the treating doctor.
Visitors with a family ticket can see every exhibit in the museum.
The database uses strong encryption for its stored passwords.
A ramp is provided at the side entrance of the theatre.

notes: Card: ' access' x10 plus ' Access', '-access'; the + pole fires on the verb before it ('gain' access, 'broke' in, 'get' in).
